title: Woman Goes Nuts After Asking For Bodycam To Be On
description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On October 22, 2022, police were dispatched a second time to a residence to deal with a dispute between a male and female in Eau Claire, WI. After consulting with each individual, the officers determined the female would be under arrest for damaging a window. She was uncooperative as officers attempted to take her into custody and began live-streaming the interaction. 

The purpose of the featured content is to show the law enforcement interaction. It is NOT to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved. Today’s world is swarmed with politics and conversations that are often misleading about our law enforcement officers. We feel it is vastly significant and imperative to show these interactions in their respective environments to inform and educate the overall public.
